suppress.notes: Spring Boot 4.0.6 BOM pins tomcat.version=11.0.21. The root build.gradle.kts forces every org.apache.tomcat.embed:*-jdk18on artifact to 11.0.22 via configurations.all.resolutionStrategy.eachDependency. Trivy on the built images confirms 11.0.22 is what actually ships. Remove this entry together with the tomcat branch in build.gradle.kts once the Spring Boot BOM moves past 11.0.21.

Spring Boot 4.0.6 BOM pins postgresql=42.7.10. The root build.gradle.kts forces org.postgresql:postgresql to 42.7.11 via configurations.all.resolutionStrategy.eachDependency. Trivy on the built images confirms 42.7.11 is what actually ships. Remove this entry together with the postgresql branch in build.gradle.kts once the Spring Boot BOM moves past 42.7.10.

Spring Boot 4.0.6 BOM pins netty.version=4.2.12.Final. The root build.gradle.kts overrides the extra property to 4.2.13.Final via the spring-dependency-management plugin, and dependencyInsight confirms every io.netty:* artifact resolves to 4.2.13.Final on the runtime classpath. Trivy on the built images confirms 4.2.13.Final is what actually ships. Remove this entry together with the netty branch in build.gradle.kts once the Spring Boot BOM moves past 4.2.12.Final.

springdoc-openapi 3.0.3 pulls org.webjars:swagger-ui:5.32.2 which ships DOMPurify 3.3.2 (CVE-2026-41238/41239/41240 + GHSA-39q2-94rc-95cp). The root build.gradle.kts overrides the webjar to 5.32.5, which bundles DOMPurify 3.4.0 (the fixed version), via configurations.all.resolutionStrategy. Trivy on the built images confirms 5.32.5 is what actually ships. Remove this entry together with the swagger-ui branch in build.gradle.kts once springdoc bumps the webjar.
